scenes.narration: Being left out may feel, to your brain, a lot like physical pain.
scenes.main_point: Show a figure standing apart while two others talk together, one hand lifting to join and then lowering
scenes.visual_objective: Show a figure standing apart while two others talk together, one hand lifting to join and then lowering

scenes.narration: So that sting when the group goes quiet is not you being dramatic.
scenes.main_point: Show a seated figure watching a phone as chat bubbles stop appearing and the screen goes still
scenes.visual_objective: Show a seated figure watching a phone as chat bubbles stop appearing and the screen goes still

scenes.narration: In one study, people left out of a game showed brain activity that rose with their distress.
scenes.main_point: Show the virtual ball game with two avatars passing to each other, the figure watching, and one small bar rising with distress
scenes.visual_objective: Show the virtual ball game with two avatars passing to each other, the figure watching, and one small bar rising with distress

scenes.narration: Another region was active too, and linked to less distress.
scenes.main_point: Show the tangle loosening and a soft ring forming around the head
scenes.visual_objective: Show the tangle loosening and a soft ring forming around the head

scenes.narration: Feeling it doesn't mean something is wrong, it means people matter to you.
scenes.main_point: Show another figure sitting down beside, a hand on the shoulder, the room warming and the heart mending
scenes.visual_objective: Show another figure sitting down beside, a hand on the shoulder, the room warming and the heart mending
